note: Links, official test data and registration steps for the Nexus ads setup wizard. Test values come only from the provider's official documentation; a provider without published test data has testData.published = false and the unregistered-device rule applies. Policy rules per platform are in docs/POLICY_COMPLIANCE.md.

sdk.nativeSource: LevelPlay's installer (SdkInstaller.PreInstallAsync, LevelPlayNetworkManager) copies the package's Editor/Json/LevelPlayVersions.json to Assets/LevelPlay/Editor/LevelPlayVersions.json, refreshes it from nativeVersionsUrl and installs the newest IronSourceSdk version inside the package's ironSourceSdkVersion range; Prepare Android does the same (package 9.6.0, read 2026-10-31, issue #144)

nativeAdapter.note: the newest adapters.UnityAds version in the versions file whose ironSourceSdkVersion range holds the native SDK; LevelPlay's Network Manager shows it as a non-removable part of the SDK. Without it every request ended in 509 Mediation No fill on a device (2026-10-24, issue #16)

sdk.gradleNote: mediation-sdk 9.5.0 brought kotlin-stdlib-jdk7/jdk8 1.6.0 next to Unity 6000.5's kotlin-stdlib 1.8.22 and Gradle stopped on duplicate classes until the BOM aligned them (device build, 2026-10-24); with mediation-sdk 9.7.0 on 6000.6.7f1 every Kotlin library resolved to 2.1.21 (2026-10-31)
sdk.gradlePropertiesNote: with a custom main template the External Dependency Manager writes android.useAndroidX/android.enableJetifier into this file and reports Resolution Failed on every resolution and build when it is missing (PlayServicesResolver.cs in googlesamples/unity-jar-resolver; seen with EDM4U 1.2.190, issue #49)

testData.note: No demo or test App Key is published. The editor mock mode initializes with the literal "editor" and mock ad unit ids such as "editor_banner"; it does not simulate latency, failures or reward logic. Test ads come from the account's own App Key on devices listed in the dashboard.

testDevices.where: LevelPlay dashboard > Settings > Test devices, by advertising id

en: Create a Unity account or sign in at cloud.unity.com with the Play Console email.
Add the app on the LevelPlay platform (an unpublished app can be added) and copy its App Key.
Create one rewarded and one interstitial ad unit for Android (and iOS when needed) and copy their ids.
Add your device's advertising id under Settings > Test devices (Google's ads settings page on the phone shows it as "Your advertising ID").
Enter the App Key and ad unit ids on the Release tab; the Test tab copies them and keeps the device list (the same advertising id).

Press Prepare Android twice: the first press adds the Ads Mediation package (com.unity.services.levelplay), the Nexus provider and the dependency resolver; the second adds the native SDK and the Unity Ads adapter and resolves them. Other networks come from Ads Mediation > Network Manager.
Fill payment and tax details before the first payout.
tr: cloud.unity.com'da Play Console e-postasıyla Unity hesabı aç ya da giriş yap.
LevelPlay platformuna uygulamayı ekle (yayınlanmamış uygulama eklenebilir) ve App Key'ini kopyala.
Android (gerekirse iOS) için bir ödüllü ve bir geçiş reklam birimi oluştur, kimliklerini kopyala.
Cihazının reklam kimliğini Settings > Test devices altına ekle (telefondaki Google reklam ayarları sayfası onu "Reklam kimliğiniz" olarak gösterir).
App Key ve reklam birimi kimliklerini Release sekmesine gir; Test sekmesi bunları kopyalar ve cihaz listesini (aynı reklam kimliği) tutar.

Prepare Android'e iki kez bas: ilk basış Ads Mediation paketini (com.unity.services.levelplay), Nexus sağlayıcısını ve bağımlılık çözücüyü ekler; ikincisi yerel SDK'yı ve Unity Ads adaptörünü ekler ve çözer. Diğer ağlar Ads Mediation > Network Manager'dan gelir.
İlk ödemeden önce ödeme ve vergi bilgilerini doldur.

en: Apply at dash.applovin.com with the company details and the Play Console email; wait for approval.
Add the app and copy the SDK key (Account > General > Keys).
Create one rewarded and one interstitial ad unit and copy their ids.
Install the plugin with AppLovin's installer package (adds the scoped registry), enable Jetifier in the Android Resolver settings.
Enter the SDK key and ad unit ids on the Release tab; add your device's GAID/IDFA to the Test tab's device list.
Fill payment and tax details before the first payout.
tr: dash.applovin.com'da şirket bilgileri ve Play Console e-postasıyla başvur; onayı bekle.
Uygulamayı ekle ve SDK anahtarını kopyala (Account > General > Keys).
Bir ödüllü ve bir geçiş reklam birimi oluştur, kimliklerini kopyala.
Eklentiyi AppLovin'in yükleyici paketiyle kur (kapsamlı kayıt defterini ekler), Android Resolver ayarlarında Jetifier'ı aç.
SDK anahtarını ve reklam birimi kimliklerini Release sekmesine gir; cihazının GAID/IDFA'sını Test sekmesinin cihaz listesine ekle.
İlk ödemeden önce ödeme ve vergi bilgilerini doldur.

en: Sign in at admob.google.com with the Play Console email (one account per publisher).
Add the app and copy the App ID into the Google Mobile Ads settings asset (Release tab).
Create one rewarded and one interstitial ad unit and copy their ids to the Release tab; the Test tab is filled with Google's sample units.
Add your device's hashed id to the Test tab's device list, or register it in the AdMob UI.
Fill payment and tax details before the first payout.
tr: admob.google.com'a Play Console e-postasıyla gir (yayıncı başına tek hesap).
Uygulamayı ekle ve App ID'yi Google Mobile Ads ayar varlığına yaz (Release sekmesi).
Bir ödüllü ve bir geçiş reklam birimi oluştur, kimliklerini Release sekmesine kopyala; Test sekmesi Google'ın örnek birimleriyle dolar.
Cihazının karma kimliğini Test sekmesinin cihaz listesine ekle ya da AdMob arayüzünde kaydet.
İlk ödemeden önce ödeme ve vergi bilgilerini doldur.
